user.title: Connect a Mac
user.description: Enable BetterDisplay's HTTP server on this Mac and enter its authentication token. Use a trusted local network only: HTTP does not encrypt the token. Do not expose the server to the internet. Add a separate entry for each Mac. Choose feature families before this manual, read-only scan; nothing is changed on the Mac. API availability and commercial use depend on your BetterDisplay version and license; a readable control does not establish license entitlement.

data_description.label: A recognizable name for this computer.
data_description.host: Bare hostname or IP address; no scheme, path, or port.
data_description.port: The port configured in BetterDisplay's HTTP server settings.
data_description.token: The HTTP server token, not an Apple or Home Assistant password.
data_description.families: Only these families are scanned and authorized. Advanced controls may black out screens, change audio, disconnect displays, or affect other displays through BetterDisplay synchronization.

targets.title: Choose targets for {mac}
targets.description: All system displays includes only supported Display records from this scan, never virtual screens or groups. Individual targets can include VirtualScreen or DisplayGroup records only with their feature family enabled. Mac-only explicitly selects no displays and requires the Mac family. Future targets are never enrolled automatically. Failed mute reads do not imply toggle support; enable manual mute toggle only for displays whose toggle behavior you have verified.

data_description.selection_mode: Choose a fixed snapshot on this Mac. An empty individual selection never means all.
data_description.display_ids: Used only for Individual targets; review device type and tag before selecting advanced targets.
data_description.mute_toggle_targets: Optional selected system displays with independently verified toggle support. This is a stateless action with no claimed mute state, not a fallback for a failed read.

confirm.title: Confirm scope for {mac}

reconfigure.title: Reconnect {mac}
reconfigure.description: A manual read-only scan must find every saved target identity. UUID-less groups and virtual screens must also retain their name. Families and selected scope are preserved, even for All displays; nothing new is enrolled. Use Configure to intentionally rescan and change scope. Mac-only entries retain their explicit global scope. Do not use this to replace one computer with another.

data_description.label: A recognizable name for the same computer.
data_description.host: The same Mac's bare hostname or IP address.
data_description.token: Re-enter the HTTP token. It is never prefilled or shown.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate {mac}
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the new BetterDisplay HTTP token. One manual read-only scan verifies the saved identities and refreshes capabilities without expanding targets or feature families.

data_description.token: The replacement HTTP server token for this same Mac.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach BetterDisplay. Check the Mac, HTTP server, hostname, port and firewall, then retry.
error.invalid_auth: BetterDisplay rejected the token. Check server authentication settings.
error.invalid_input: Enter a nonempty Mac name and token, a bare hostname or IP address, valid port and known feature families.
error.invalid_response: BetterDisplay returned an invalid or ambiguous response. Check the app version and server settings.
error.unsupported_control: The requested discovery or control is unsupported. Check BetterDisplay's version and HTTP server.
error.already_configured: This hostname and port are already configured in another entry.
error.selection_required: Explicitly choose All system displays, Individual targets or Mac-only.
error.no_selection: Select at least one supported target. Empty never means all; use explicit Mac-only for global controls.
error.invalid_selection: Choose each target only once from the eligible list on this Mac.
error.invalid_mute_selection: Manual mute-toggle targets must be selected system displays with the Audio family enabled.
error.mac_family_required: Enable the Mac feature family before choosing Mac-only.

abort.already_configured: This hostname and port are already configured in another entry.
abort.identity_mismatch: The scan did not find every saved identity. UUID-less targets must retain their saved name. Nothing changed. Restore the original targets or use Configure to explicitly change this Mac's selection; add a separate entry for another Mac.

init.title: Configure this Mac
init.description: Choose a manual rescan or manage event webhooks independently. Opening this menu makes no network request.

rescan.title: Rescan {mac}
rescan.description: Submitting performs one read-only scan of the chosen families. Existing targets, capabilities and consent remain unchanged until final confirmation. This is not a write to the Mac. Pro availability and hardware support determine which capabilities can be read. Removing families removes their controls and can break automations.

data_description.families: Explicit authorization to discover these families. Advanced controls may black out screens, change audio, disconnect displays or affect other targets.

targets.title: Choose new scope for {mac}
targets.description: All system displays replaces the snapshot with supported Display records found now, never virtual screens or groups. Pick advanced targets individually with the corresponding family enabled. Mac-only requires the Mac family. Targets absent from this snapshot will be removed after confirmation. Manual mute toggle requires explicit knowledge of support; failed reads do not establish support.

data_description.selection_mode: A new fixed snapshot; future targets are not added automatically.
data_description.display_ids: Used only for Individual targets. Review device types and tags.
data_description.mute_toggle_targets: Selected system displays whose stateless mute toggle you have independently verified. No mute state is inferred.

confirm.title: Confirm new scope for {mac}

events.title: Event webhooks for {mac}
events.description: Select saved system displays to receive BetterDisplay event callbacks. No rescan or outbound request occurs. Each display gets a separate random secret URL; retained selections keep their existing secret. Deselecting disables and removes that URL. Webhooks accept only local GET callbacks, never trigger state reads, and are not proof of a display's current state. Configure a Home Assistant internal URL reachable by the Mac first.

data_description.display_ids: Empty disables all event webhooks for this Mac. Only already-selected system displays are eligible.

events_confirm.title: Save event webhook configuration
events_confirm.description:
After saving, copy each secret URL into the corresponding display's BetterDisplay event callback setting. Keep the event-hook placeholder exactly as shown; BetterDisplay substitutes the event name. Do not append display names or identifiers. Treat these URLs as credentials: do not publish, log or share them. They are not exposed as entity attributes or in diagnostics. Saving sends no request to the Mac.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach BetterDisplay. Check the Mac and HTTP server, then retry the manual scan.
error.invalid_auth: The saved token was rejected. Reconfigure or reauthenticate this Mac.
error.invalid_input: Check the selected families and saved connection settings.
error.invalid_response: BetterDisplay returned an invalid or ambiguous response. Check app and server settings.
error.unsupported_control: The requested discovery or control is unsupported by this server.
error.selection_required: Explicitly choose All system displays, Individual targets or Mac-only.
error.no_selection: Select at least one eligible target, or explicitly choose Mac-only with the Mac family enabled.
error.invalid_selection: Choose each eligible target only once from this Mac's list.
error.invalid_mute_selection: Manual mute-toggle targets must be selected system displays with the Audio family enabled.
error.mac_family_required: Enable the Mac family in the rescan before choosing Mac-only.
error.internal_url_required: Set Home Assistant's internal URL in network settings to an address reachable from this Mac, then retry. No event settings were changed.
